Preview notice · 13 October 2026

Keyboard and focus

Navigation groups, forms, dialogs, demo tabs, and review actions support keyboard use. A Skip to content link appears on focus. Dialogs close with Escape and return focus to the control that opened them.

Readable information

Text uses contrasting colors and visible labels. Statuses include words as well as color. Classification alternatives stack on narrow screens; evidence details open in a readable sheet.

Motion choices

The product film has a pause control. With reduced motion enabled, the complete poster is shown, and reveals, flips, and shutters become immediate state changes. No review decision depends on watching an animation.

Charts and diagrams

Synthetic figures have descriptive alternatives. Interactive cost and queue charts include equivalent values in text or a data table. The film has a written transcript.

Forms and errors

Controls have visible labels, required indications, and field-specific errors. Consent checkboxes start unchecked. Errors preserve entered values.

Feedback and limits

This preview has been checked at desktop and mobile widths with keyboard interaction. It is not represented as independently certified accessibility compliance. Prepare feedback on the contact page with the Accessibility topic; the form does not send until an operator service is connected.

Privacy choices

Keep diagnostics local.

Optional interaction diagnostics stay in this browser session. No form details or raw product records are recorded, and nothing is transmitted to an analytics provider.
